text_extraction.annotated_text: Reaction template: [reactant] Carboxylic acid (10) [SMILES:[1*]C(=O)O] + [reactant] Amine (11) [SMILES:*N([2*])[3*]] --(DATB 8a [reagent][ABBREVIATION][label: DATB (8a, 0.5-5 mol%)], Toluene; MS4Å [reagent])--> [product] Amide (3) [SMILES:[1*]C(=O)N([2*])[3*]]. Examples: [reactant] Acid 10a [SMILES:CCC(C)(C(=O)O)c1ccccc1] + [reactant] Amine 11c [SMILES:[3*]Nc1ccc(OC)cc1] -> [product] 3a [SMILES:CCC(C)(C(=O)Nc1ccc(OC)cc1)c1ccccc1] (89% yield; 5 mol% DATB 8a, 80 °C, 14 h). [reactant] Acid 10c [SMILES:COc1cccc(OC)c1C(=O)O] + [reactant] Amine 11d [SMILES:[3*]NCc1ccccc1] -> [product] 3b [SMILES:COc1cccc(OC)c1C(=O)NCc1ccccc1] (86% yield; 5 mol% DATB 8a, 80 °C, 14 h). [reactant] Acid 10d [SMILES:Cc1cc(C)c(C(=O)O)c(C)c1] + [reactant] Amine 11e [SMILES:[3*]NCC1CC1] -> [product] 3c [SMILES:Cc1cc(C)c(C(=O)NCC2CC2)c(C)c1] (89% yield; 5 mol% DATB 8a, 80 °C, 6 h). [reactant] Acid 10e [SMILES:O=C(O)C1(c2ccccc2)CCCC1] + [reactant] Amine 11b [SMILES:[3*]NCCc1ccccc1] -> [product] 3d [SMILES:O=C(NCCc1ccccc1)C1(c2ccccc2)CCCC1] (88% yield; 5 mol% DATB 8a, reflux, 14 h). [reactant] Acid 10f [SMILES:O=C(O)c1cc2ccccc2[nH]1] + [reactant] Amine 11a [SMILES:[3*]NCc1ccccn1] -> [product] 3j [SMILES:O=C(NCc1ccccn1)c1cc2ccccc2[nH]1] (90% yield; 5 mol% DATB 8a, reflux, 14 h). [reactant] Acid 10g [SMILES:O=C(NC1(C(=O)O)CCCCC1)c1ccccc1] (gram scale) + [reactant] Amine 11b [SMILES:[3*]NCCc1ccccc1] -> [product] 3k [SMILES:O=C(NC1(C(=O)NCc2ccccc2)CCCCC1)c1ccccc1] (93% yield; 2 mol% DATB 8a, reflux, 18 h). Additional examples (3e-3l) are annotated in the mapping below.

entities.note: Shown in image as DATB 8a (0.5-5 mol%); used at 5 mol% in most examples; 2 mol% in gram-scale run.

graphical_alignment_notes: Mapped image template reactants to SMILES: carboxylic acid template = [1*]C(=O)O; amine template = *N([2*])[3*]; product template = [1*]C(=O)N([2*])[3*].

Aligned each labeled example (3a-3l) to the corresponding reactant/product SMILES from the graphical extraction. Amine structures in the graphical JSON are represented with generic attachment points (e.g., [3*]) where appropriate; those were preserved in annotations.

DATB was reported in the image as 'DATB 8a (0.5-5 mol%)' in the header; individual example conditions show 5 mol% for most entries, and a 2 mol% loading for the gram-scale example (3k). The tool output flagged the DATB label as potentially uncertain; this annotation uses the image text as authoritative.

Where exact text in the image used shorthand labels (e.g., '17', '18' for internal condition references), I used the explicit condition strings visible under each example (yield, catalyst loading, temperature, time) when present.

If you want full canonical SMILES for DATB (8a) or explicit drawn structures for each amine (resolve [3*] placeholders), provide the molecule images or a mapping file and I will expand the [SMILES:...] entries accordingly.
